_about: Components: the equipment a mech's die is made of. Each is exactly one entry on the die (its face: the engine's word for one entry). Nothing generic exists: every entry on a die is a component, or an empty hardpoint. A component a chassis lists under fixed is built in and is never bought or crafted, which is what makes it unique. Numbers are in tens. Kinetic entries carry power and power_max and roll between them, and may crit; energy entries are static and never crit. Keywords are a list; authored entries should stay under the validator's cap, upgrades may push past it. passive is null or one object, same shape as a chassis passive. A face's kind makes it a weapon (attack: spent on a foe, need not deal damage) or equipment (shield, vent: spent on a machine); equipment may carry targets, self_ally (the default), self or ally, and the die shows a chip for a narrowed one. design.stage is draft until Ryan signs the entry off as final; nothing is final yet. Shown to the player: codex (the inspect entry), flavour (a quote); both still to be written. design is internal and never shown: fantasy, niche. Numbers are placeholders.

design.fantasy: Two swings a round if the dice agree. Ghouls in threes.
design.notes: Reach melee since 26 September (authored melee is allowed now): the front rank, and the back only once the front is gone.

design.fantasy: As many missiles as it could carry. The box on the Badger's deck.
design.niche: Minerva's indirect fire: the tank that reaches the back rank.
design.notes: Claude's fill, 26 September, so the Badger's missiles exist as a component.

design.fantasy: One big round. Warm barrel.
Bolt-on armour that comes off in sheets so the hull does not.
Reliable, unremarkable, always there.
A beam that goes through the wall and the thing hiding behind it.
Small, rude, lands behind the front rank.
Fins. Lots of fins.
The back rank's problem, twice per die.
Lands, then keeps landing.
Whatever it was about to do, it is not doing it now.
Empties the reactor jacket onto the ground. Or onto a friend.
A little armour is better than the amount you had.
Kestrel removed the safety interlock and called it a feature.
design.notes: Was overcharge (double damage, double heat) at 50 and 20; the keyword is retired and the numbers baked in (26 September). A temporary component either way.

design.fantasy: For finishing what someone else started.
Lightning that picks its own second target.
A very expensive bubble.
A shadow falls across the target and it forgets what it was about to do.
design.niche: Aphelion's suppress: a flat energy number on a line, so the control lands every time it comes up.
design.notes: Claude's fill, 26 September; name and numbers are Ryan's to move.

design.fantasy: Lobbed light. It lands at the same brightness every time and keeps burning.
design.niche: Indirect burn with a steady roll: predictable stacks for the passive to read.

design.fantasy: A ring of light that scours whatever the rift left on the metal.
design.niche: The cleanse carrier: shield an ally and clear its statuses.

design.fantasy: A small fast gun that gives the machine its turn back.
design.niche: The tempo tool: a rapid entry so a control frame gets another look at its die.
design.notes: Claude's fill, 26 September; the first rapid component in the pool.
